differences.what: Product is larger in frame and better lit in B: the cabinet front reads at a higher, more open level (median lum about 61 vs 52), so the woofer surround, the slot panels and the bottom ports are legible, where in A the cabinet sits murky and nearly merges with the dark ground
Warm rim and edge light along the cabinet's vertical corners and top edge in B separates the box from the set; in A the edges are only a thin dim line
Ground in B carries raking light shafts and pools that lead the eye into the product and give depth; A's ground is a flat, dark, uniform brown band with little modelling

Fog in B washes the background and the trees on the right to near white, flattening the depth and lowering global contrast; A keeps the tree trunks as dark graphic verticals and reads as a richer, moodier frame
Campfire reads more clearly in A: logs and embers hold contrast against a darker ground; in B the fire is hazed over and the logs dissolve into the fog
Horn shell shows blotchy, mottled denoiser smear across its dark surface in both frames, slightly more visible in B because it is larger and brighter; neither is shippable at this surface quality
Cabinet sits on the ground with a soft contact shadow in both, but A's darker exposure hides whether it is grounded; B shows the base meeting the soil with a visible shadow edge
